lede: Nvidia is investigating whether chief executive Jensen Huang was targeted by a Chinese spy after an alleged affair, and the story is surfacing at once across Hacker News, Mastodon and the AI news wire. Ramayana: Part 1 led Wikipedia with 785,245 views, and a magnitude 6.4 quake struck near Lata in the Solomon Islands.

throughlines.title: Abdul El-Sayed
throughlines.gist: Abdul El-Sayed is both a top Wikipedia read at 437,069 views and the subject of a Polymarket market on the 2028 Democratic nomination, so public attention and betting interest are landing on him together.

throughlines.title: the legend of zelda: ocarina of time
throughlines.gist: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is lighting up Google Trends and YouTube at the same time, where a single video has drawn 1,088,979 views.

throughlines.title: Nvidia investigates whether CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by Chinese spy following alleged affair
throughlines.gist: Nvidia has opened a probe into whether CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by a suspected Chinese spy following an alleged affair, a story now running across the AI news wire, Hacker News and Mastodon.
